mentions.name: Flame Game Jam 2026 game entry
mentions.description: A game being built as an entry for the 2026 Flame Game Jam, developed with the Flame Engine on top of Flutter. It is the author's first game jam, aiming to submit the game before the Sunday deadline.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've joined this year's Flame Game Jam which uses the Flame Engine built on top of Flutter. This is my first game jam and I really hope I manage to submit the game before the deadline on Sunday.
